title: Path Sum
problem: Given the root of a binary tree and an integer targetSum, return true if the tree has a root-to-leaf path such that adding up all the values along the path equals targetSum.
constraints: Number of nodes is up to 5000.
edge_cases: TargetSum doesn't reach a leaf node
hints: Subtract node value from targetSum and recursively check children. A leaf node must have targetSum == node.val.
